dedupe_keys.name: state of the art of plants of the particle and fibreboard industry

description: State of the Art of Plants of the Particle- and Fibreboard Industry is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltbundesamt.at. This report describes the state-of-the-art of particle board and fibre board manufacturing facilities, including plants in Austria and Luxembourg. The emphasis is on the production processes, the raw materials used and the products, as well as on plant-specific emissions associated with the different manufacturing processes and relevant emission reduction measures. Coverage: AT. Its keywords include Emissionen, OpenDocument. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
